notes: Fixed blank reverse gear in Mono and blank neutral/reverse gears in Retro and Radar when using SimHub.
Matched Mono neutral and reverse letters with consistent full-stroke glyphs while preserving the numeric gear style.
Added explicit Direct GT7 Wi-Fi and SimHub USB connection modes with persistent on-device selection.
Added a shared SimHub Custom Protocol for all seven dashboard themes, including missing-value handling and transient neutral filtering.
Redesigned first-time touch, Wi-Fi, connection and reset flows with recoverable setup and direct connection switching from the Waiting screen.
Updated Device Settings and bilingual SimHub documentation for the new dual-source workflow.
Redesigned the Wi-Fi setup screen with a QR code for joining GT7-DASH-SETUP, clearer manual connection instructions and the setup address.
Added the Endurance dashboard theme, optimized for at-a-glance race telemetry with shift lights, a central gear display, lap timing, tyre temperatures, pedal inputs and fuel strategy.
Added EV detection from GT7 fuel-capacity telemetry across all six dashboard themes.
Added compact whole-number EV energy display and vehicle-aware FUEL or EV labels.
Added EV visual energy gauges while keeping remaining-lap estimates disabled for electric vehicles.
Separated EV classification from energy-value validation to prevent transient telemetry from showing the wrong powertrain label.
Added the Pocket dashboard theme with a Game Boy-inspired pixel interface optimized for 320 x 240 displays.
Added telemetry-driven pixel RPM, timing, fuel-level, ABS and TCS indicators, with isolated redraws for stable updates.
Added a persistent idle-screen Touch Setup flow for correcting 0, 90, 180 or 270 degree touch orientation.
Improved shared dashboard icon rendering and refined fuel-pump placement across Pocket, GT3 and Mono themes.
Added the Mono dashboard theme with a minimalist black-and-white digital instrument layout.
Added a segmented monochrome shift-light, dynamic GT7 alert marker and shift-warning pulse.
Refined Mono timing, position, lap, delta, fuel, remaining-lap, tyre, pedal and driving-aid presentation for 320 x 240 displays.
Improved Classic dashboard recovery when a temporary sprite allocation fails after switching themes.
Redesigned Theme Selection with live renderer previews and fixed mock telemetry data.
Added looping theme navigation, compact applied/preview indicators, and persistent Apply or non-destructive Cancel actions.
Added a full-screen theme preview with a clear tap-to-return control.
Centralized the theme catalog and decoupled Classic and GT3 renderers from live telemetry for easier future theme expansion.
Kept heartbeat, UDP telemetry, discovery, Wi-Fi and sleep handling independent from theme preview rendering.
Improved Radar theme readability with larger lap, position, fuel, remaining-lap and delta values.
Refined Radar lap formatting with compact spacing around the separator.
Improved Retro theme readability with larger current time, fuel, remaining-lap, lap and position values.
Adjusted Retro current-time and delta placement to prevent overlap.
Added switchable GT3, Classic, and Retro dashboard themes with persistent on-device selection; GT3 remains the default.
Added the touch Settings menu: tap an active display to open Settings, or tap a sleeping display to wake it.
Added Device Settings with persistent 20–100% brightness control and protected Wi-Fi reset access.
Refined the Classic min-alert RPM marker and increased Retro gear readability.
